user.title: Create Wasp in a Openbox
user.description:
Create an occupancy sensor that handles periods of no motion.
Supports enclosed rooms (doors) and open passages (border/curtain sensors).

data_description.wasp_id: Select the motion sensor for the room.
data_description.box_id: Select the door sensor for the room. Leave empty if the room has no door (use border sensors instead).
data_description.door_closed_delay:
Set the delay (in seconds) after the door is closed before determining if the room is occupied. If motion is detected when the delay expires, the helper is set to occupied.
Should be set to about 10 seconds above how long your motion sensor stays active after motion has stopped.
data_description.door_open_timeout: The timeout (in seconds) after which if there is no motion detected and the door is open, the helper will be set to unoccupied.
data_description.immediate_on:
When enabled, occupancy turns on immediately when motion is detected or the door is opened.
When disabled, the door closed delay applies before turning on.
data_description.border_ids: Select curtain PIR or passage sensors that detect movement between this room and adjacent spaces. These are motion sensors mounted in doorways or archways without physical doors.
data_description.border_correlation_window: Time (in seconds) to wait for room motion after a border sensor triggers to confirm an entry. Set this above your border PIR's cooldown period.
data_description.border_exit_timeout: Time (in seconds) after a border crossing with no resumed room motion before considering the room vacated.
data_description.border_only_mode: Enable for rooms with no physical door. Occupancy relies entirely on border sensor + room motion correlation. The door sensor field is ignored when this is enabled.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Reset the occupancy sensor to off and clear any pending timers and border event history.

force_entry.name: Force entry
force_entry.description: Manually signal an entry event, setting the room to occupied.

force_exit.name: Force exit
force_exit.description: Manually signal an exit event, setting the room to unoccupied and clearing all timers.
